bodyHtml:
AI measurement

Measure, compare, improve: the complete solution for controlled battery consumption and your AI impact

Are you developing an application that embeds AI and want to guarantee optimal battery life on all your users' smartphones?

Our unique test bench in Europe, combined with Greenspector Studio software, gives you the ideal solution to accurately assess your application's energy consumption, whatever the model (Android or iOS) and its year of manufacture.

Benefits

Why choose our solution?

A unique test bench in Europe

Our specialised infrastructure enables rigorous tests across a wide range of devices, covering all categories (entry-level, mid-range, high-end) and operating systems (Android & iOS).

Device booking and test parallelisation

With Greenspector Studio, you can easily book smartphones, automate your tests and run analyses in parallel to save time. No more waiting days for results: our tools speed up your testing and optimisation process.

Precise battery discharge analysis

Our solution lets you accurately measure the energy impact of your AI application on each smartphone category. You can then anticipate discharge time and adjust your fixes accordingly.

Sectors

Which sectors?

Whether you work in gaming, entertainment, navigation, outdoor sports, e-commerce or services, our solution adapts to all your needs. With a fine-grained analysis of battery consumption, you can:

User experience

Improve the user experience by guaranteeing longer battery life.

Technical costs

Reduce the technical costs of post-launch fixes.

Immediate decisions

Make immediate decisions to optimise your application before deployment.

Method

How it works

1

Book your devices

Book your devices via Greenspector Studio.

2

Run tests in parallel

Run your tests in parallel on several smartphones at once.

3

Analyse the results

Analyse the results to identify points of excessive consumption.

4

Fix and retest

Apply fixes and retest to validate the improvements.

Your turn

Don't let the battery limit your application!

With our unique test bench in Europe and Greenspector Studio, you have a powerful tool to guarantee optimal energy performance. Test now and make sure your AI application, including an on-device AI application, works perfectly on all your users' smartphones.

Contact us to find out more and start your AI measurement tests!

Greenspector Studio – The energy ally of your AI application.
